entities.name: Bohuslav Šťastný
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bohuslav Šťastný is a Czech retired professional ice hockey player. He played in the Czechoslovak Extraliga for HC Pardubice. He was a member of the Czechoslovak 1976 Canada Cup team, and was a silver medalist at the 1976 Winter Olympics, and a bronze medalist at the 1972 Winter Olympics.
